places.name: Leiden
places.connection: Leiden is the birthplace of Rembrandt, a prominent artist of the Dutch Golden Age.

places.name: Rembrandt House Museum
places.connection: Rembrandt, a key figure of the Dutch Golden Age, had his studio here.

places.name: Mauritshuis
places.connection: Mauritshuis features works from the Dutch Golden Age, including seascapes.

places.name: Rijksmuseum
places.connection: The Rijksmuseum holds a significant collection of Dutch Golden Age seascapes.

places.name: Zuiderzee
places.connection: The Zuiderzee was a common subject in Dutch Golden Age seascapes.
